title: Transcutaneous forceps-assisted en-bloc removal of a large intra-articular loose body during operative temporomandibular joint arthroscopy
html: Large intra-articular loose bodies of the temporomandibular joint can limit operative arthroscopy when their size prevents retrieval through working trocars. Fragmentation, portal enlargement, accessory approaches, or open conversion may increase intra-articular manipulation and morbidity. This technical note describes a transcutaneous forceps-assisted maneuver for en-bloc removal of a large loose body under continuous arthroscopic visualization. The technique is illustrated in a 52-year-old woman with Wilkes stage IV internal derangement, pain of 7/10 on a visual analog scale, and maximal mouth opening of 32 mm.
